WOLF.why: Conditional $1.5B DoW/OSC delayed-draw loan commitment letter requiring >=$750M new equity + convert equitization -> Tier B. Gate 3 fail: 0.33x ADV30 premarket (large-cap under-read; re-grades 3* only if >=1x ADV by 09:45).
